title: Melissa officinalis essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Melissa officinalis essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the leaves of the lemon balm plant. It is widely used in herbalism for its calming and soothing properties. This essential oil is known to help alleviate anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve mood. It can be applied topically, diffused into the air, or used in aromatherapy practices. In traditional medicine, it is also used to support digestion and ease symptoms of nervousness.
